class.name: PlayerCameraServer
class.description: The one owner of the player's view: the cab of the vehicle driven ([PlayerServer]), the free camera (walking) or the camera following a vehicle, which vehicle and in which view. Everything that changes the view - F4, Shift+F4 (drivermode.cpp:1244-1277, 803-804), the HUD, scripts ([code]maszyna.camera[/code]) - calls these operations by the vehicles' [RailVehicleServer] handles. The server holds the view and announces it; the cameras are the player's node's, which follows [signal camera_changed] and [signal camera_placed]. Named apart from Godot's own [code]CameraServer[/code] (camera feeds).

method.name: camera_cycle_follow_view
method.description: Shift+F4: following, the next view of [enum CameraFollowView]; else the vehicle the player drives is followed.

method.name: camera_get_follow_view
method.description: The view the following camera takes.

method.name: camera_get_show_transform
method.description: Where [method camera_show_vehicle] puts the free camera: beside the vehicle, looking at it. The player's node starts following a far vehicle from there rather than flying to it.

method.name: camera_get_target
method.description: The vehicle the following camera follows, an invalid [RID] for none.

method.name: camera_set_follow_view
method.description: The view the following camera takes; the camera following now takes it.

method.name: camera_set_mode
method.description: The view from the cab (only with a vehicle driven), the free camera - going on from where the view was - or the following camera (only with a target).

method.name: camera_set_target
method.description: The vehicle the following camera follows; following now, it follows this one. Cleared while following, the view becomes the free camera. A freed vehicle is cleared.

method.name: camera_show_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle card's crosshair: the free camera stands beside the vehicle, at least 12 m away and further for a longer vehicle, looking at it. [signal camera_placed] comes before [signal camera_changed], so nothing following the view moves the camera elsewhere.

method.name: camera_toggle_cabin
method.description: F4: from outside - following or walking - back into the cab of the vehicle driven (following with none, the free camera); in the cab, out of it - the player's node puts the free camera beside the vehicle (DistantView, drivermode.cpp:1060).

signal.name: camera_changed
signal.description: The mode, the target or the follow view changed.

signal.name: camera_placed
signal.description: The free camera is to stand at [param transform].

constants.constant: From the cab of the vehicle driven.
The free camera - the player walking.
The following camera, following the target.
From a point beside the track the trainset drives by.
